description: `HTTPResponse.from_httplib` was removed in urllib3 2.0.0: code using it fails.
`contrib.ntlmpool` was removed in urllib3 2.0.0: code using it fails.
migration_hint: Removed the deprecated ``urllib3.contrib.ntlmpool`` module (`#2339 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/2339>`__). (urllib3's changelog for 2.0.0)

description: `exceptions.SNIMissingWarning` was removed in urllib3 2.0.0: code using it fails.
`HTTPConnectionPool._prepare_conn` was removed in urllib3 2.0.0: code using it fails.
migration_hint: Removed the ``_prepare_conn`` method from ``HTTPConnectionPool``. Previously this was only used to call ``HTTPSConnection.set_cert()`` by ``HTTPSConnectionPool`` (`#1985 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/1985>`__). (urllib3's changelog for 2.0.0)
source_excerpt:
2.0.0 (2023-04-26)
Removed
* Removed the ``_prepare_conn`` method from ``HTTPConnectionPool``. Previously this was only used to call ``HTTPSConnection.set_cert()`` by ``HTTPSConnectionPool`` (`#1985 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/1985>`__).

description: `HTTPSConnection.tls_in_tls_required` was removed in urllib3 2.0.0: code using it fails.
migration_hint: Removed ``tls_in_tls_required`` property from ``HTTPSConnection``. This is now determined from the ``scheme`` parameter in ``HTTPConnection.set_tunnel()`` (`#1985 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/1985>`__). (urllib3's changelog for 2.0.0)
source_excerpt:
2.0.0 (2023-04-26)
Removed
* Removed ``tls_in_tls_required`` property from ``HTTPSConnection``. This is now determined from the ``scheme`` parameter in ``HTTPConnection.set_tunnel()`` (`#1985 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/1985>`__).

description: `HTTPResponse.getheaders`, `HTTPResponse.getheader` are deprecated in urllib3 2.0.0: a later release may remove it.
migration_hint: Deprecated ``HTTPResponse.getheaders()`` and ``HTTPResponse.getheader()`` which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0. Instead use ``HTTPResponse.headers`` and ``HTTPResponse.headers.get(name, default)``. (`#1543 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/1543>`__, `#2814 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/2814>`__). (urllib3's changelog for 2.0.0)
source_excerpt:
2.0.0 (2023-04-26)
Deprecated
* Deprecated ``HTTPResponse.getheaders()`` and ``HTTPResponse.getheader()`` which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0. Instead use ``HTTPResponse.headers`` and ``HTTPResponse.headers.get(name, default)``. (`#1543 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/1543>`__, `#2814 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/2814>`__).

migration_hint: Deprecated ``HTTPSConnection.set_cert()`` method. Instead pass parameters to the ``HTTPSConnection`` constructor (`#1985 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/1985>`__). (urllib3's changelog for 2.0.0)

description: `HTTPConnection.request_chunked` is deprecated in urllib3 2.0.0: a later release may remove it.
migration_hint: Deprecated ``HTTPConnection.request_chunked()`` method which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0. Instead pass ``chunked=True`` to ``HTTPConnection.request()`` (`#1985 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/1985>`__). (urllib3's changelog for 2.0.0)
source_excerpt:
2.0.0 (2023-04-26)
Deprecated
* Deprecated ``HTTPConnection.request_chunked()`` method which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0. Instead pass ``chunked=True`` to ``HTTPConnection.request()`` (`#1985 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/1985>`__).

2.0.0 (2023-04-26)
Added
* Added ``urllib3.response.BaseHTTPResponse`` class. All future response classes will be subclasses of ``BaseHTTPResponse`` (`#2083 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/2083>`__).
